entry.title: SwiftSync -- Speeding up IBD with pre-generated hints (PoC)
entry.summary:
Floresta has recently integrated an implementation of SwiftSync, a method designed to optimize synchronization processes. This advancement leverages the implicit deletions technique for Utreexo, which aims to improve efficiency in managing unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs). By utilizing implicit deletions, the system reduces the need for explicit proof data, streamlining chain state updates and minimizing the volume of transmitted information during initial block download.
Details about this addition can be found in [the pull request on Floresta’s GitHub](https://github.com/getfloresta/Floresta/pull/1115), while further technical insights into implicit deletions for Utreexo are available in [the Delving Bitcoin discussion](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/implicit-deletions-and-improvements-in-utreexo-ibd/2881). These resources elaborate on the operational improvements and underlying mechanisms, providing context for developers interested in adopting or understanding this approach.
With this integration, Floresta continues to enhance performance and scalability by reducing synchronization overhead, offering a more efficient solution for lightweight blockchain clients.
